data.prompt: Medium shot of a small apartment entryway by the front door: A-Fu the Corgi himself stands upright in a brown jacket over his striped pyjamas, sneakers on, plain car keys dangling from one paw, a plain wristwatch with no numbers on his other wrist, an impatient face.
data.motion: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> taps the glass of his wristwatch hard again and again until a crack appears on it, rolls his eyes toward the right edge of the frame and lets out a huge sigh, his round belly sinking. The camera holds a static shot.

data.prompt: Medium shot of a white bathroom door opened only a narrow crack: Zhenzhu the Shiba herself peeks out through the gap, heavy dramatic eye makeup on only her left eye, her right eye bare, a makeup brush in her paw, a blank stare.
data.motion: The Shiba shown in <Picture 1> stares through the gap without blinking, then very slowly pulls her face back and closes the bathroom door; the door clicks shut. The camera holds a static shot.

data.prompt: Wide shot of the same small entryway: A-Fu the Corgi himself still stands in the same spot in his brown jacket and striped pyjamas holding the car keys out, but he has grown a long white beard reaching the floor, his whole body draped with dusty cobwebs, a cobweb strung between the keys and his ear, and three small chicks in a bird's nest on top of his head; through the window behind him snow is falling.
data.motion: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> stands completely still; his long white beard sways slightly; the three chicks in the nest on his head open their beaks and chirp; snowflakes drift past the window. The camera holds a static shot.

data.prompt: Close-up of A-Fu the Corgi himself with a long white beard, cobwebs hanging from his big ears, three small chicks in a bird's nest on top of his head.
data.motion: The Corgi shown in <Picture 1> slowly draws in a huge breath, cheeks puffing, about to sigh again; the three chicks in the nest above all turn their heads down and glare at him; he freezes and swallows the breath. His mouth stays closed. The camera holds a static shot.
